thread:
jane_auditor: Quick follow-up from the SOC 2 engagement — we need a 90-day sample of access/audit logs covering KMS key operations (CreateKey, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey), HSM admin actions, and any cross-account key usage. Please include sampling method, filters used, and MD5/SHA256 hashes for exported bundles. Deadline: COB Wed 2026-01-14.

samir: Got it. Clarifying Qs: 1) Do you want full raw logs or truncated/redacted versions with PII removed? 2) For HSM ops, do you need the vendor console events or syslog exports from the HSM appliance?

jane_auditor: Raw logs preferred for chain-of-custody, but redaction of customer-identifiable data is fine if flagged. For HSM we need appliance syslog plus audit trail from the HSM management plane (vendor console).

maria: We can produce both. Plan: export CloudTrail events filtered by eventName and eventSource, plus KMS CloudWatch logs where applicable. For HSM we'll pull syslog from the appliance and include the management API audit. We'll produce an evidence bundle and a manifest with file hashes.

samir: Quick sketch of filters I'll run (AWS example):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time 2025-10-16T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-01-14T23:59:59Z
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/kms/usage" --filter-pattern \"Encrypt OR Decrypt OR GenerateDataKey\" --start-time 1700000000000 --end-time 1769000000000
```
I will also include `eventName` filters: CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, DisableKey, and GenerateDataKey.

lisa_support: FYI — support tickets referencing affected customers must be redacted before upload. If you need ticket IDs for correlation, tell me and I will provide a mapping file with hashed IDs.

maria: Export path (will be created and ACL-locked): s3://redwood-audit-uploads/1769007777-jane/ . We'll put one tarball per log source + manifest.json (manifest will include SHA256 and MD5). Ops-bot will start the export job and post status.

ops-bot: export_job_1769007777 started for cloudtrail, kms logs, hsm-syslog. ETA ~45m. Upload destination: s3://redwood-audit-uploads/1769007777-jane/ .

samir: For chain-of-custody, I'll include: export script, git commit id for the export tools, who initiated the export (samir), the server hostname, and checksums. Example manifest fields: source, start_time, end_time, file_name, sha256, md5, exported_by.

jane_auditor: That's perfect. Also need mapping to SOC 2 criteria (e.g., CC6.2, CC7.1) for each artifact so the report can reference controls.

devon: I'll map artifacts to SOC 2 sections. For example: CloudTrail exports -> CC6.2 (monitoring and logging), KMS usage -> CC6.5/CC6.6 (cryptographic key management), HSM syslog -> CC7.3 (logical access and system hardening). I'll attach a short spreadsheet.

maria: One more note on retention: CloudTrail is configured to 1 year for management events and 7 years for analytics copy. We will include the configuration screenshots and lifecycle policy in the bundle.

samir: Repro steps for the auditor if they want to validate a sample locally:
```
# download sample tarball
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-uploads/1769007777-jane/cloudtrail-2025-11-sample.tar.gz ./
# verify checksum
sha256sum cloudtrail-2025-11-sample.tar.gz
# inspect events
gunzip -c cloudtrail-2025-11-sample.tar.gz | jq '.Records[] | select(.eventName=="Decrypt")' | less
```

jane_auditor: Excellent, thank you. Last ask: please timestamp each exported file with exported_at and include the UTC timezone. We'll confirm receipt once uploaded.

maria: Will do — exported_at and exported_by in the manifest. Ops-bot will post completion and the s3 presigned urls.

ops-bot: export_job_1769007777 completed. Files uploaded: cloudtrail-2025-10-to-2026-01.tar.gz (sha256: 3f7a...c4), kms-usage-2025Q4.tar.gz (sha256: 1a2b...9f), hsm-syslog-2025-10-2026-01.tar.gz (sha256: d9e1...7b). Presigned URLs will be delivered via encrypted email per compliance policy.

jane_auditor: Received initial bundle confirmation via email. I'll validate hashes and follow up with any gaps by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

samir: tagging @lisa_support to confirm ticket-id mapping export is ready for redaction step.

lisa_support: mapping file ready at s3://redwood-secure-maps/mapping-1769007777.csv (access via secure console only).

jane_auditor: Great — if I find any missing events I'll list exact timestamps and example event ids so you can repro. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

samir: noted — we'll be standing by.
